correctness.rationale: The exact domain has 1225 designs. Unitary two-projection spectral decomposition gives seven eigenvalues 1 and 1±sqrt(1-h_j). A complete explicit action of 294 affine transformations partitions all pairs into seven exact orbits. The executable certificate computes det(5G−7I) on every orbit with integer cyclotomic arithmetic. Six orbits have negative determinant at the strict threshold 1/5; the seventh has three positive Sylvester minors. This rigorously isolates 147 winners. Its characteristic cubic and distinct optimizer geometry are verified by direct algebra. Finite arithmetic is exhaustive for this finite theorem; numerics are not proof.
